issues.description: Script uses GM.xmlHttpRequest to connect to weav3r.dev, which is a third-party server. This may transmit user interaction data or page context, depending on request payloads.
issues.recommendation: Review all transmitted data to ensure no sensitive information (user credentials, cookies, personal data) is sent. Limit data to only what is necessary for functionality.

issues.description: Script reads and writes to localStorage for settings and caching, but does not appear to transmit this data externally. No evidence of document.cookie, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB access for sensitive data.
issues.location: localStorage usage in GM_getValue/GM_setValue compatibility layer
issues.recommendation: Ensure no sensitive user data is stored in localStorage. Avoid storing authentication tokens or personal information.

issues.description: Script requests more @grant permissions than it uses (both legacy and modern GM APIs).
issues.recommendation: Remove unused permissions to reduce attack surface and follow the principle of least privilege.

issues.description: @require is not used, but @downloadURL and @updateURL point to greasyfork CDN, which is generally trusted. No supply chain risk detected.
issues.recommendation: If adding @require in the future, pin to official, versioned CDN URLs.

script_name: Bazaars in Item Market Powered by TornW3B
summary: The script transmits data to a third-party server (weav3r.dev) using GM.xmlHttpRequest, which is a critical risk if sensitive data is sent. No evidence of credential or keylogging behavior. No code obfuscation or XSS risk detected. Some permission overuse and localStorage usage, but no major privacy collection. Overall, the script is relatively safe for typical use, but users should be aware of the external data transmission.
